name: Vietnam

fees.name: Vietnam e-Visa - single entry
fees.notes: Fee set by Ministry of Finance Circular No. 28/2026/TT-BTC (effective 1 Apr 2026), which replaced Circular 25/2021/TT-BTC and Circular 62/2023/TT-BTC. Paid online in USD at application on the official portal.

fees.name: Vietnam e-Visa - multiple entry
fees.notes: Fee set by Ministry of Finance Circular No. 28/2026/TT-BTC (effective 1 Apr 2026).

fees.name: Visa-on-arrival stamping fee - single entry
fees.applies: nationalities eligible for VOA with a pre-approved visa letter
fees.notes: Stamping fee payable in cash (USD or VND) at the airport on arrival, separate from a private visa-letter service fee charged by travel/visa agents (not an official government fee, varies by agent). Same rate as the e-visa stamping fee under Circular 28/2026/TT-BTC.

fees.name: Visa-on-arrival stamping fee - multiple entry
fees.applies: nationalities eligible for VOA with a pre-approved visa letter
fees.notes: Stamping fee payable in cash (USD or VND) at the airport on arrival.

fees.name: Embassy/consulate sticker visa (tourist) - single entry
fees.notes: Vietnamese embassies/consulates confirm fees follow the national stamping-fee schedule (Circular 28/2026/TT-BTC): USD 25 single-entry / USD 50 multiple-entry for standard processing; embassy pages do not publish a separate line-item fee table and direct applicants to the consular division. Expedited service may cost more.

fees.name: Embassy/consulate sticker visa (tourist) - multiple entry
fees.notes: Follows the national Circular 28/2026/TT-BTC stamping-fee schedule.

fees.name: Business visa (DN1/DN2) - embassy/e-visa route
fees.notes: Business visa stamping fee generally follows the same single/multiple-entry schedule (USD 25/50) under Circular 28/2026/TT-BTC, but an official line-item confirming this specific category was not located; set to null rather than guessed. Verify directly with the immigration department before publishing a firm number.

fees.name: Transit visa
fees.notes: Most nationalities transiting Vietnam without leaving the international zone, or staying under visa-exempt transit rules, do not need a visa. No official fee schedule for a standalone transit visa was found on evisa.gov.vn; left null rather than guessed.

free_visa_notes: Vietnam unilaterally exempts a list of nationalities (e.g. many ASEAN countries, and since 2023 an extended list including most Western Europe, Japan, South Korea) from a visa for short stays (typically 45 days); those travellers pay no visa fee. All other nationalities must obtain an e-visa, embassy sticker visa, or (where eligible) visa-on-arrival, at the USD 25 (single-entry) / USD 50 (multiple-entry) government fee described above. No official, publicly documented nationality-specific fee variations (e.g. for IND, USA, GBR, CHN, NGA, PAK, PHL, BGD, RUS, CAN) were found beyond this single/multiple-entry structure that applies uniformly to all fee-paying nationalities; Vietnam does not appear to operate a reciprocity-based differential fee schedule like some other countries.
